title: ScenarioSpec
description: One what-if scenario for the opportunity-map pipeline: an ordered list of deterministic mutations over a baseline run's FormalRule set, plus the provenance basis that keeps the scenario traceable WITHOUT pretending to carry a legal citation it does not have. GenAI (Phase B, docs/GENAI_SEAMS.md) may only ever author a ScenarioSpec proposal (proposedBy = 'llm-proposal#...'); the deterministic engine executes it and the critic validates it. Mutations are deliberately restricted to what the zone engine actually consumes (zoneSemantics, bufferDistanceM, rule presence) — conditions are never re-derived by a scenario.

id.description: Stable scenario id; also used as the per-scenario geometry filename stem.

objectType.description: Must match the baseline request's objectType; validated again by the scenario runner.

type.description: baseline = unmutated control (synthesised by the runner, never authored); norm_variance = varies a parameter of a CITED rule (normCardId required); policy_variant = flips a documented discretionary choice (normCardId required); hypothetical = free parameter exploration with NO legal grounding (rationale required) — the abstention ledger's honest counterpart.

normCardId.description: The cited NormCard this scenario varies or whose discretionary clause it flips. Required for norm_variance and policy_variant; resolved against the baseline run's normcards.json by the V2 check.

variedAspect.description: What parameter/aspect is varied (e.g. 'buffer_distance 1500m -> 500m'). Required for norm_variance.

rationale.description: Why this hypothetical is worth exploring despite having no verified citation (e.g. an abstained topic such as setback distances). Required for hypothetical.

provenanceNote.description: Human-readable grounding note: for norm_variance/policy_variant, how it relates to the cited card; for hypothetical, an explicit 'not legally grounded' statement.

ruleId.description: Must resolve in the baseline run's formalrules.json. Unknown ids fail the V2 grounding check; known-but-not-executable rules (status ambiguous/rejected) are skipped with a recorded reason, never guessed.

action.description: drop = remove the rule from execution; set_semantics = reclassify (e.g. conditional overlay -> hard exclusion, or exclusion -> marker); set_buffer_distance_m = set/replaces the zoneSelector buffer distance (metres, EPSG:28992).

proposedBy.description: Author of the spec, agent#run form. Phase A: 'deterministic-scenario-author#poc-v0'. Phase B (GenAI): 'llm-proposal#<model>/<version>' — the seam where an LLM ScenarioAuthor may propose, never decide.
